in_hebrew.name: פלורי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word פלור (plor), which means 'to bloom' or 'to flow'. It is a beautiful name for a girl, symbolizing new beginnings, growth, and the promise of a prosperous future.

in_greek.name: Φλορρί
in_greek.long_meaning: A name of Greek origin, meaning 'flower'. It is a lovely name for a girl, reminding us of the beauty and fragility of nature, as well as the fleeting nature of life. In Greek mythology, Floros was the god of flowers and fruit trees.

in_latin.name: Florri
in_latin.long_meaning: A name of Latin origin, meaning 'flower'. It is a popular name for girls in the Christian tradition, as well as in many other cultures. The name is derived from the Latin word 'flos', which means 'flower'. In the New Testament, there is a reference to a 'crown of flowers' given to the righteous.
